items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I was going out with Angela Bofill at the time too, and she was the second artist signed.

ctx.x: And it’s not that prevalent in the music business anymore to have a group that hangs together like that for so many years.

Exactly. And the other analogy is that being with GRP for eighteen years. That’s kind of strange too. But after a while, I think I was the mentsh of the company I guess they call it. They really, being the first artist signed, and I was going out with Angela Bofill at the time too, and she was the second artist signed. They made tons of money with her. They were very happy. And after a while I would go to Vladius and go, “Am I making another record?” He’d go, “Yeah.” “So after, do you want to hear the masters?”…
You mean he gave you just free reign to go out and do the thing?
